title: Liquid Defies Gravity
description: Discover the bizarre world of superfluids

scenes.narration: Liquid defies gravity, what's going on here?
It's a superfluid, a state of matter where liquids behave like gases
With zero viscosity, it can flow uphill
And climb up walls, against gravity
This bizarre behavior is due to quantum effects
Superfluids are the future of quantum technology, and it's mind blowing
